<?php
// Test sites: pretend every email sends.
add_filter( 'pre_wp_mail', '__return_true' );

<?php
// Test sites only: list a presence room's client IDs so tests can check them.
add_action( 'rest_api_init', static function () {
	register_rest_route( 'voiceboard-test/v1', '/presence', array(
		'methods' => 'GET',
		'permission_callback' => '__return_true',
		'callback' => static fn ( WP_REST_Request $r ) => function_exists( 'wp_get_presence' ) ? array_values( array_map( static fn ( $e ) => $e->client_id, wp_get_presence( (string) $r['room'] ) ) ) : array(),
	) );
} );
